title: The Three Malformations and Their Cleansing
description: The central operation of the deeper work. T44 — the three settled malformations of selfhood (salted truth, darkened understanding, self-consuming love) hidden together in every self-loving arrangement, met by the wise physician who works in stillness with antidote upon antidote, until the inner image being born within the natural at last comes forth. T45 — the threefold purification by descent and answering ascent: pure truth meets corrupted truth, light meets darkness, love meets self-love, each pair drawn out by correspondence-of-likeness. T46 — the Living Spirit's three formative acts: scattering wind, setting wheels, casting down deceits, fashioning the bound circuit of the natural with twelve seals upon it. T47 — the Lord's forestructure: every disorder met by an order already prepared, the holding-place existing before the thing held, the bound set before the falling.
